pkgmetadata.longdescription: Fcitx5 Lotus is a Vietnamese input method engine for the Fcitx5 framework, forked from VMK. It supports multiple typing methods (Telex, VNI, custom keymaps) and several input processing modes, including a non-preedit "smooth" mode via a privileged uinput server for seamless text replacement.

use.flag: Install the OpenRC init script for fcitx5-lotus-server
